explanation: Met The Funeral, Édouard Manet, accession 10.36, ca. 1867, Public Domain, unfinished. Probably but not certainly depicts Baudelaire's Sept 2 1867 funeral, which Manet attended. Few mourners and threatening weather. Panorama from vicinity of Mouffetard in Paris, Panthéon and Val-de-Grâce; held by Manet until his death, acquired by Pissarro in 1894 by exchange for a landscape. Original PR #3 two-paragraph draft retained; existing art facts and curation unchanged.
